name: lvid.route/escalation/jev_pair
source: Escalation between Jev-Omni and OneJev-27B on other long-video leaves (built for this benchmark)
license: Inherits the licenses of the quoted source questions
criteria_source: Written; gold = the stronger system B answers the original question correctly and A does not
notes: 500 questions from Video-MME, VSI-Bench, VideoMMMU, Ego4D-NLQ, UCF-Crime, QVHighlights and Charades-STA, each with system A's actual answer quoted (250 escalate, 250 not). A (Jev-Omni) and B (OneJev-27B) are frozen, fixed systems whose answers are recorded: the item asks whether, for this fixed pair, the question should go from A to B, so any model can be scored on it. The 70 items that quote Ego4D queries and the 113 that quote Video-MME ship as a recipe; `jevarena-mm build` fills them in from those sources' annotations (fetched with the videos; Ego4D needs its license).

name: lvid.route/segment/qvhighlights
source: QVHighlights saliency scores, validation split (Lei et al., 2021)
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (annotations); YouTube videos, no license stated
criteria_source: Original five-level saliency scale (0 Very Bad to 4 Very Good)
notes: 482 videos, 500 two-second clips; gold is the distribution of the three annotators' ratings.
